text:
zoe: Hey folks — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/412 to rename metric `request.lat_ms` -> `request.latency_ms` and add a small trace tag normalization. This touches dashboards (dash/query.json) and the tracehook placement in runtime hooks. Can someone review before EOD? Particularly the migration script, grafana panel queries, and the trace tag key. :wave:

sam: @zoe :eyes: I'll skim it now, expect feedback in ~1h.

maya: I can take dashboards — will check panels, templating, and variables. Do we have a runbook note for alert owners?

zoe: migration is included under `scripts/migrate_metrics_v2.sql` — it backfills the new metric and leaves an alias for 7 days. added `ENABLE_METRIC_ALIAS` flag in config and a short runbook note in docs/observability.md.

deploy-bot: Deployment window reminder: console-canary scheduled at 16:30 UTC if PR merges before 15:30 UTC. :robot_face:

alex: Quick callout — alerts referencing `request.lat_ms` will break if alias isn't in place. Did you add aliased alert rules or notify owners?

zoe: yes — `alerting/aliases.yml` maps old -> new for 7d and I pinged alert owners in #eng-sre already. added a comment in the PR with the alert list.

maya: Dashboard review done: small suggestion on panel 3 query, prefer explicit cast of duration to ms to avoid NaN on empty values. left an inline comment on the PR.

sam: looked at tracehook changes, code is fine but left a nit about avoiding allocations in hot path (use stack buffer). also added a test suggestion for tag normalization.

tay: FYI from SRE — we'll coordinate updating alert subscriptions once this lands to prod. thanks for the alias.

alex: Approving pending sam's nit being addressed. :+1:

zoe: Thanks all — I'll fix the nit, update the PR, and aim to merge before the canary cutoff. Ping me if you need me to hold the merge for additional checks.

sam: Great — assign back to me after the change and I'll recheck quickly.
